scope.selection: Inherited root Cargo.lock, exact prost/prost-build 0.14.4 declarations, workspace default features. No manifest or lockfile edits.

nestedSupervisorLock.note: Different file bytes/local package membership; root workspace lock is authoritative for workspace invocations.

toolchainContext.declaredMsrvComparison: 1.99.1 exceeds all packaged declared MSRVs; this is not a compile or compatibility certification.
toolchainContext.upstreamSupportAndToolchainAuthenticity: Not established by this Cargo-only artifact; use separate toolchain evidence.

archiveClosure.budgetCheck: Before each write, free bytes minus archive size exceeded 10 GiB. Two archives only, exact SHA256 compared with inherited lock before persistence.
archiveClosure.warning: Archive availability is a byte inventory only. The 36 inherited archives remain in read-only shared cache; no claim of portable offline Cargo home/index/config completeness.

provenance.authentication: HTTPS upstream registry metadata and SHA256 byte comparison only; inherited lock is not an independent trust anchor.
provenance.licenseSource: Read packaged Cargo.toml and license/copyright files inside checksum-matching .crate archives without extracting or executing code. Repository URL is a declaration, not proof of a signed source commit.

linuxHostGraph.method: Static workspace manifests, locked dependency edges, archive manifests/features and target clauses; no cargo metadata, build, build.rs or procedural macro execution. Advisory check deliberately covers ALL 38 locked packages, a superset of consumed Linux dependencies.

windowsExclusionEvidence.edge: windows-link, reachable only through excluded windows-sys for this graph

linuxHostGraph.conditionalCaveat: rustix backend cfg/build-script decisions and optional libc/errno features were not executed. These packages remain in the conservative reviewed superset; do not interpret package inventory as measured runtime linkage.

protocExternalRequirement.note: External protoc is required by the current build script; its provisioning/version belongs to separate S01 evidence.

advisoryReview.scope: All 38 registry name/version pairs, including platform-only and conditional packages.

osv.coverage: Exact version queries; each empty result means no advisory returned for that package/version by OSV at query time, not proof of no vulnerabilities.

rustsec.method: Parsed every crates/*/*.md TOML advisory in pinned upstream snapshot, selected all matching package names, manually compared selected versions to patched ranges.

limitations: Time-bounded known-advisory evidence, not security certification or independent code audit.
Severity is absent from some RustSec records; no invented severity. All seven package-name matching advisories are excluded by patched version ranges, irrespective of severity.
OSV and RustSec can overlap and are not guaranteed complete or immediately synchronized. Rerun advisory review before later gates or after lock changes.

notes: Preserve SPDX OR alternatives and AND obligations as declared; no automatic choice of an OR branch.
unicode-ident requires Unicode-3.0 in conjunction with MIT OR Apache-2.0.
rustix/linux-raw-sys include LLVM-exception alternatives; foldhash declares Zlib; prost family declares Apache-2.0.
This is development inventory, not a signed legal review or complete redistributed license/notice bundle.
